name: Index
line: A strict Swiss 12-column index in black and white: thick rules, a single red Group 1 numeral standing for 'same certainty', and each explorer's three figures set as giant numerals that drift sideways in opposite directions as you scroll; link rows invert to black on hover.
notes: Red is used once, for the giant '1'. Network drawings and game screenshots are shown in greyscale (games regain colour on hover). Small secondary text uses #5E5E5E because #8C8C8C fails AA on white; the grey is kept for rules. Without JavaScript or with reduced motion the numeral rows sit still and wrap if needed. Host Grotesk is Latin-only, so Chinese and Russian pages would need a fallback.
